Museums and historical sites often attract more tourists than local residents. This may be because local people are less interested in familiar attractions and because admission fees can discourage regular visits. Several measures could help address this problem.

One major reason is that local residents may find museums and historical sites less interesting than tourists do. Having learned about these places at school or visited them before, they may feel that there is little new to discover. Tourists, however, are often eager to explore unfamiliar history and culture. Another reason is that local authorities sometimes charge high admission fees. While tourists may consider these costs worthwhile during a short trip, local residents may be less willing to pay repeatedly to visit familiar attractions.

Several measures could encourage more local residents to visit. Firstly, museums and historical sites could organise regularly changing exhibitions, cultural events and workshops. These activities would provide fresh experiences and encourage people to rediscover their local heritage. Secondly, local authorities could offer free admission days or discounted tickets for residents. For example, historic temples could provide free entry during traditional festivals, allowing local people to take part in cultural activities without paying an admission fee. Such measures could increase local interest and make these attractions more accessible.

In conclusion, familiarity and high admission fees may discourage local people from visiting museums and historical sites. More engaging activities and affordable entry could help attract residents and strengthen their connection to local heritage.

title: 纸质报纸和书籍是否会消失：个人作文（节选存档）
original:
It is true that more and more people choose to read online rather than physical books nowadays, however I don’t consider printed books or newspapers would necessarily disappear in the future. Because physical books won’t be replaced both for individuals and society, especially in some special circumstance.

A growing number of people preferring electronic books can mainly attributed to its convenience and cost-effectiveness. People can obtain instant massages and keep up with the world just trough their phone. It has developed to a daily habit that people are used to check their phone at the first second after waking up. The news happened in other side of the world can transport over the world within one hour. In addition, people can scroll some articles and novels just during their commutes or their waiting time, without carrying heavy books with them. On top of that, price of electronic books can be quite affordable than physical books and many online articles are even open freely to public, which saving a large part of cost for people. As a result, there are more and more people change to online reading.

However, even though the advantages of digital reading are obvious, the function of physical books and newspapers can’t be replaced totally. Firstly, the messages are more reliable in this way because there are specialized staff checking the information source and the printing mistakes before open to public. And these reliable messages can be quite important especially in some public urgent circumstance. For example, many online message came out instantly during the period of covid-19, while many unjustified messages misleading people and resulting in public panic. However the information from newspapers can give people comfort and inform them the important regulations. Moreover, the users of physical newspaper and books are mainly old generations because they are not comfortable of using digital device. Therefore, we should also take the requirements of these people into consideration.

Overall, although reading online have the benefits to people, we should combine it with physical books and newspapers rather than replacement of that. Physical books and newspapers have their necessity to exist and can bring more advantages than drawbacks to individuals and society.

This essay will examine the potential caues of it and argue that, on balance, it brings more drawbacks to individuals and society if regarding owning a home as a neccessary requirement.

It's understandable that owning a home can provide a sense of stability and satisfaction in some countries. Owning a house or flat means you have a place to stay when you face with difficulties like unemployment and going broke. You don't need to figure out the renting expenditure and it will definitely give you a stable backing up force. In addition, owning a home even is a symbol of satisfaction for most ordinary peope, and someone takes it as an important goal through a long period, for example, owning a home becomes a former condition of marriage for many Chinese. As a result, many of them have to lend money from their families or even from loan companies, resulting in much more living pressure. title: 澳大利亚年龄与就业率：个人原稿、完整批改与双版本
type: Task 1 · 折线图 · 练习估分约5.5
original:
The line graph compares the percentages of employees aged 18 to 34 in terms of men and women in Australia, in 1976 and 2011.

Overall, the employment rate increased as age growing older, expecting the proportion of women employmees in 2011, with a fluctuate trend among ages. While the emolyment rates of men were leading that for women in both years, through age 18 to 34.

In 1976, the men employment proportion rose from 70% in age 18 to 92% approximatedly in age 34, while that for women workers growed from 63% in age 18 to 71% in age 43, with a smoother increasing trend in general.

However, the emoloyment rates for these two sexual were overly fell in 2011, compared with that in 1976. The number of men employees increased steadily along with the age growing, the proportion rising from 60% in age 18 to 75% in age 34. However, the figure for women in 2011 rose to 58% in age 23 before felling to only 54% in age 28. Then, the women employees proportion increased back to 55% in the age of 34, representing the highest figure for women employees in 2011.
feedback:
这篇原稿的练习估分约为 **Band 5.5**。你按 **1976 年、2011 年**分段的思路合理，也看出了 **2011 年女性就业率先升、后降、再回升**。最影响提分的是把这条线的**最终回升读成了 55%**，以及在概述里漏掉了一个全图规律：**在每个年龄点，男女各自的就业率在 2011 年都低于 1976 年。**

## 一、整体评分与任务分析

这是一张**按年龄比较就业率的折线图**。横轴是 **18–34 岁**，图例是 **1976 年和 2011 年**。写同一条线时，用 *at age 18 … at age 34* 比较不同年龄。比较年份时，用 *in 2011 … in 1976*，并保持性别和年龄一致。

| 官方评分维度 | 练习估分 | 原文依据与提分方向 |
|---|---:|---|
| **Task Achievement** | 5–6 | 概述识别了男性高于女性和 2011 年女性曲线的例外。但 2011 年男性终值、女性回升后的终值和若干转折点读错，影响了关键特征的呈现。 |
| **Coherence and Cohesion** | 6 | 四段分工明确。按年份分段可行，但最后一段连续使用 *However*，第一个表示跨年对比，第二个实际是在转向女性组。 |
| **Lexical Resource** | 5 | 有 *rose from … to …*、*the figure for women* 等准确表达。*employees proportion*、*these two sexual* 和多处拼写错误降低了精确度。 |
| **Grammatical Range and Accuracy** | 5 | 尝试了 *while*、比较替代和 *before + -ing*，但出现了独立的 *While* 从句、*were fell*、*growed*、*felling* 等错误。 |

**最影响提分的三件事**是①先校对曲线末端和转折点；②在概述里同时说明**年龄规律、性别差距和年份差异**；③固定用 **employment rate + 谓语** 描述比例，并区分 *at age 18* 和 *in 1976*。

## 二、逐段批改

### P1 · Introduction

> The line graph compares the percentages of employees aged 18 to 34 in terms of men and women in Australia, in 1976 and 2011.

| 我的原表达 | 错误原因 | 推荐修改 | 知识点总结 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `the percentages of employees aged 18 to 34` | 容易理解成“雇员当中 18–34 岁的人所占的比例”。图中的分母是**相应年龄和性别的人群**。 | **the employment rates of Australian men and women aged 18 to 34** | **employment rate** 直接点明指标。也可写 *the percentage of people in employment*。 |
| `in terms of men and women in Australia, in 1976 and 2011` | 性别可以直接接在 *employment rates of* 后面，最后一个逗号也可以去掉。 | **the employment rates of men and women aged 18 to 34 in Australia in 1976 and 2011** | 图中只给两个年份，用 **in 1976 and 2011** 准确交代范围。 |

### P2 · Overview

> Overall, the employment rate increased as age growing older, expecting the proportion of women employmees in 2011, with a fluctuate trend among ages. While the emolyment rates of men were leading that for women in both years, through age 18 to 34.

| 我的原表达 | 错误原因 | 推荐修改 | 知识点总结 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `increased as age growing older` | `as` 在这里引出从句，原句缺限定动词。图表比较不同年龄的人群，可以直接用 *with age*。 | **Employment rates generally rose with age.** | **rise with age** 简明地表达年龄越高，数值总体越高。 |
| `expecting … with a fluctuate trend` | “除了”用 **except**。**fluctuate** 是动词，*a fluctuate trend* 词形错误。 | **… except among women in 2011, whose employment rate fluctuated.** | **except among + 人群**。写细节时，用 *rose, dipped and then recovered* 说明波动形态。 |
| `While the … rates of men were leading that for women …` | *While* 从句缺主句。*were leading* 在这里不如 *were higher than* 自然。若前文用复数 *rates*，替代时用 **those**。 | **Men’s employment rates were higher than those of women at every age in both years.** | **those of women** 代替 *the employment rates of women*。强调同年龄比较，用 **at every age**。 |

### P3 · Detail 1

> In 1976, the men employment proportion rose from 70% in age 18 to 92% approximatedly in age 34, while that for women workers growed from 63% in age 18 to 71% in age 43, with a smoother increasing trend in general.

| 我的原表达 | 错误原因 | 推荐修改 | 知识点总结 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `the men employment proportion` | 名词组合不自然，且 *men* 和 *employment* 的关系没有表达清楚。 | **the employment rate for men** / **the male employment rate** | 第一次点明指标，后面可接 **the figure for women**。 |
| `70% in age 18 to 92% approximatedly in age 34` | 年龄用 **at age**。拼写是 **approximately**，通常放在数字前。 | **from 70% at age 18 to around 92% at age 34** | **from X to Y** 表示起终值。也可写 *among 18-year-olds*。 |
| `that for women workers growed … in age 43` | **`that for` 的结构用对了**，它可以承接前面的单数 *rate*。动词过去式是 *grew*，终点年龄应为 **34**。 | **while that for women rose from about 63% at age 18 to around 71% at age 34** | **the rate for men → that for women**。用 **women** 就能标明比较组。 |
| `with a smoother increasing trend in general` | *smoother* 暗示变化更均匀，但女性曲线上有数段持平。你观察到的更明显的区别是**增幅较小**。 | **The increase among women was much smaller.** | 男性约增加 **22 个百分点**，女性约增加 **8 个百分点**。比较幅度可以用 **a smaller increase**。 |

### P4 · Detail 2

> However, the emoloyment rates for these two sexual were overly fell in 2011, compared with that in 1976. The number of men employees increased steadily along with the age growing, the proportion rising from 60% in age 18 to 75% in age 34. However, the figure for women in 2011 rose to 58% in age 23 before felling to only 54% in age 28. Then, the women employees proportion increased back to 55% in the age of 34, representing the highest figure for women employees in 2011.

| 我的原表达 | 错误原因 | 推荐修改 | 知识点总结 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `the … rates for these two sexual were overly fell … compared with that` | **sexual** 是形容词。*were fell* 混用了 **were lower** 和 **fell**。复数 *rates* 用 **those** 承接。 | **In 2011, employment rates for both men and women were lower than those recorded in 1976 at every age.** | 对比两个年份的水平，**were lower than** 最直接。图表只给两个年份，无法判断期间是否持续下降。 |
| `The number of men employees increased … to 75% in age 34` | 图中是**就业率**。2011 年男性在 **30 岁约为 75%**，到 **34 岁是 80%**。 | **The male employment rate rose steadily with age, from 60% at age 18 to 80% at age 34.** | 报终值前，沿着正确颜色的曲线找到最右端，再核对横轴年龄。 |
| `rose to 58% in age 23 before felling to only 54% in age 28` | 读图约为 **23–24 岁 57%**、**28–29 岁 53%**。*fall* 的 -ing 形式是 **falling**。 | **It reached around 57% at ages 23 and 24 before falling to about 53% at ages 28 and 29.** | **before falling to + 终值**。连续两个年龄读数相同时，可以合写。 |
| `increased back to 55% … representing the highest figure` | 34 岁的点约为 **59%**。你判断“达到该组最高值”的方向是对的，问题在于 **55%** 这个读数。 | **It then climbed to about 59% at age 34, the highest figure for women in 2011.** | **climbed to** 适合这里的回升。**returned to** 适合回到先前达到过的同一水平。 |

## 三、数据取舍与 Overview

图上没有逐点标注百分比。下表中 **63%、57%、53%、59%** 等读数来自刻度估读，正文用 *about* 或 *around*。

| 要说明的特征 | 优先选的数据 | 为什么这样选 |
|---|---|---|
| **男性两条线随年龄上升，1976 年始终较高** | 1976 年 **70% → 约 92%**，2011 年 **60% → 80%** | 两组起终点都用 **18 岁和 34 岁**，可以同时看出年龄方向和年份差异。中间年龄无需逐一列出。 |
| **1976 年女性就业率增幅较小** | **约 63% → 约 71%** | 和同年的男性起终值配对后，读者可以看出男性与女性的差距由约 **7 个百分点**扩大到约 **21 个百分点**。正文可写起终值，或再补一句差距，无需把两种比较各写一遍。 |
| **2011 年女性曲线先升、后降、再回升** | 18 岁约 **53%**，23–24 岁约 **57%**，28–29 岁约 **53%**，34 岁约 **59%** | **57% → 53% → 59%** 是这条线最有辨识度的形状。若篇幅有限，省去 18 岁的起点仍能写清三个阶段。 |
| **年份和性别的比较范围** | 同年、同龄下男性高于女性。同龄、同性别下 1976 年高于 2011 年。 | 这两条适合放进概述。图中约 19–20 岁的交叉发生在 **2011 年男性**与 **1976 年女性**之间，不影响同年男女比较，正文可省略。 |

你的 **Overview** 已经找到了“总体随年龄上升”和“2011 年女性例外”。优化时，加上**两个年份的水平差异**，并明确性别比较是在**同一年、同一年龄**下进行的。

> **Overall, employment rates generally rose with age, although the figure for women in 2011 fluctuated. At every age, men had higher employment rates than women in both years, and the rates for both sexes were lower in 2011 than in 1976.**

## 四、可复制的错题库与高频表达

| 分类 | 错误表达 → 正确表达 → 使用场景 → 示例句 |
|---|---|
| 趋势词汇 | `a fluctuate trend` → **fluctuated** → 有升有降 → *The female employment rate fluctuated in 2011.* |
| 数据比较 | `the number of men employees rose to 80%` → **the male employment rate rose to 80%** → 纵轴是百分比 → *The male employment rate reached 80% at age 34.* |
| 固定搭配 | `as age growing older` → **with age** → 横轴是年龄 → *The rate rose steadily with age.* |
| 时态与词形 | `were overly fell` → **were generally lower** → 比较两组已经结束的年份 → *Employment rates were lower in 2011 than in 1976.* |
| 冠词、单复数和介词 | `in age 18` → **at age 18** → 交代某个年龄点 → *The figure stood at 70% at age 18.* |
| 从句与衔接 | `While the rates of men were higher.` → **Men’s rates were higher, while women’s rates varied more by age in 2011.** → 用 *while* 连接两个完整分句。 |

**本题最值得积累的 10 个表达**

| 表达 | 可迁移例句 |
|---|---|
| **the employment rate for [group]** | *The employment rate for men reached 80% at age 34.* |
| **at every age shown** | *Men’s employment rates were higher at every age shown in both years.* |
| **rise steadily with age** | *The male employment rate rose steadily with age in 2011.* |
| **rise from X to Y** | *The figure rose from 60% to 80%.* |
| **increase more modestly** | *The rate for women increased more modestly in 1976.* |
| **that for [group]** | *The male employment rate was higher than that for women in 1976.* |
| **those recorded in [year]** | *The rates in 2011 were lower than those recorded in 1976.* |
| **stand at around X** | *The figure for women stood at around 53% at age 18 in 2011.* |
| **reach X before falling to Y** | *The figure reached around 57% before falling to about 53%.* |
| **reach its highest point at age X** | *The female employment rate in 2011 reached its highest point at age 34.* |

## 五、两个修改版本

### 版本 A · 保留原意的修正版

保留你按 **1976 年 → 2011 年**组织正文的方式。

> The line graph compares the employment rates of men and women aged 18 to 34 in Australia in 1976 and 2011.
>
> Overall, employment rates generally rose with age, although the rate for women in 2011 fluctuated. Men recorded higher rates than women at every age in both years. For both sexes, employment rates were lower in 2011 than in 1976 at every age shown.
>
> In 1976, the employment rate for men rose from 70% at age 18 to approximately 92% at age 34. The figure for women also rose, but by a much smaller amount, from around 63% to 71% over the same age range.
>
> In 2011, the male employment rate rose steadily with age, from 60% at age 18 to 80% at age 34. The figure for women, meanwhile, increased from around 53% at age 18 to about 57% at ages 23 and 24 before falling to around 53% at ages 28 and 29. It then climbed to approximately 59% at age 34, the highest figure for women that year.

### 版本 B · Band 7.5–8 目标版

这一版按**男性、女性**分段，约 **180 词**。每段都在同一性别内比较两个年份，让四条线的关系更容易看清。

> The line graph compares employment rates among Australian men and women aged 18 to 34 in 1976 and 2011.
>
> Overall, employment rates generally rose with age, although the figure for women in 2011 fluctuated. Men were more likely to be employed than women of the same age in both years. For each sex, rates were lower in 2011 than in 1976 across the entire age range.
>
> Among men, employment rates rose steadily with age in both years. In 1976, the figure climbed from 70% at age 18 to approximately 92% at age 34. The corresponding figures for 2011 were 60% and 80%, respectively.
>
> The rise with age among women was more modest in 1976, with the rate increasing from about 63% at age 18 to around 71% at age 34. In 2011, the female rate started at about 53% and reached around 57% at ages 23 and 24. It then dipped back to about 53% at ages 28 and 29 before climbing to 59% at age 34, its highest point that year.

## 六、复盘与短句训练

**本次最值得记住的五点**：①年龄用 **at age**，年份用 **in**。②指标是比例时用 **employment rate**。③切换组别可用 **that for women**，承接多项就业率用 **those**。④描述曲线起伏可用 **rose … before falling …**。⑤概述写总体关系，正文挑起终值和关键转折点作证。

**你这篇最易重复的三个问题**是年龄点与数值错配、名词和动词形式混用，以及用 *while* 开头后缺主句。

> **个人易错点记录｜Task 1 · 年龄与就业率**  
> `in age 34` → `at age 34`  
> `a fluctuate trend` → `the rate fluctuated`  
> `were fell` → `were lower`  
> `before felling to` → `before falling to`  
> **读图复核**：先对图例，再确认该点的横轴年龄和纵轴百分比。2011 年两条线在 34 岁分别为男性 **80%**、女性约 **59%**。

**短句练习**

1. 改错：*The number of male employees rose from 60% in age 18 to 80% in age 34.*
2. 用 **those** 改错：*The employment rates in 2011 were lower than that in 1976.*
3. 把两句用 **while** 合并：*The male employment rate rose steadily with age in 2011. The female rate fluctuated.*
4. 用 **before falling to** 翻译：2011 年，女性就业率在 23–24 岁达到约 57%，随后在 28–29 岁降至约 53%。

**参考答案**

1. The male employment rate rose from 60% **at age 18** to 80% **at age 34**.
2. Employment rates in 2011 were lower than **those recorded in 1976**.
3. The male employment rate rose steadily with age in 2011, **while the female rate fluctuated**.
4. In 2011, the female employment rate reached around 57% at ages 23 and 24 **before falling to** about 53% at ages 28 and 29.

Some people argue that small classes are essential for learning a foreign language, while others believe that class size makes little difference. ### **重点：measure 和 measurement 的区别**

这两个词你之前也容易混淆，建议重点记忆。

## **P2｜Body 1：食物浪费的原因**

### **1. 中心句**

你的原句：

> Many people saw a heavy food waste these days, citing the improvement of productivity and consuming ability, and an unhealthy consuming habit.

主要问题：

- *saw a heavy food waste*：搭配错误。
- *consuming ability*：不适合表达消费者购买能力或消费水平。
- *unhealthy consuming habit*：应使用 *wasteful consumption habits*，但本题中 *purchasing habits* 更准确。

推荐：

> **Food waste is largely driven by an oversupply of food and the tendency of consumers to purchase more than they need.**

这里的 **be driven by** 非常适合原因分析题，表示“主要受……驱动”。

### **2. Reason 1｜生产与供应过剩**

你的原句：

> Living in a rapidly developing age, the productivity is greater with the help of advanced infrastructure and producing system.

这是典型的悬垂分词问题。

*Living in a rapidly developing age* 的逻辑主语应该是人，但你的主句主语是 *the productivity*，相当于说“生产力生活在快速发展的时代”。

更自然的写法：

> Advances in production technology and distribution systems have made it possible to supply food more efficiently and at lower costs.

重点记住：

**make it possible to do something**

例如：

- make it possible to produce food more efficiently
- make it possible to access online education
- make it possible to reduce operating costs

下一句：

> In that sense, food produce can be more efficient and effective and people can purchase much food in a reasonable price.

主要搭配问题：

| 原表达                     | 推荐表达                         |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| food produce            | food production              |
| efficient and effective | more efficient               |
| purchase much food      | buy large quantities of food |
| in a reasonable price   | at a reasonable price        |

注意：

**at a reasonable price**

不能写 *in a reasonable price*。

### **3. 供应过剩如何导致浪费？**

你的原句：

> However, the effective producing can easily lead to product overload especially for food in a short service date.

这里最值得记住的表达是：

**a short shelf life：保质期较短。**

其他修改：

- *effective producing* → efficient food production
- *product overload* → oversupply / excess stock
- *short service date* → short shelf life

推荐：

> **However, when food supply exceeds actual demand, unsold products with a short shelf life may eventually be discarded.**

这句话可以直接迁移到环境与经济类作文。

### **4. 圣诞节的例子**

你的原句：

> For example, a large amount of food is produced before holidays like Christmas Day, while a part of them without being purchased were thrown away directly after the holidays.

这句同时存在代词、时态、非谓语与被动语态问题。

推荐：

> **For example, supermarkets may stock extra fresh food before major holidays such as Christmas, only to discard some of it when demand falls afterwards.**

其中有一个很好的结果结构：

**only to + 动词原形**

表示“结果却……”，通常体现出乎预料或不理想的结果。

例如：

> Retailers may order large quantities of fresh produce, only to find that much of it remains unsold.

这里必须注意：这种表达是在说明可能发生的情况，不意味着所有超市都会在节后丢弃剩余食品。

### **5. Reason 2｜过度购买**

你的原句：

> Meanwhile, many people having an unhealthy consuming habits may purchase more food than they actually need, resulting in a large waste at last.

问题：

- *many people having*：这里可以直接使用 *consumers who have*。
- *an unhealthy consuming habits*：冠词与复数不一致。
- *resulting in a large waste*：不自然。

推荐：

> **Meanwhile, many consumers purchase more food than they can actually eat, causing edible products to go to waste.**

这里值得背诵：

**go to waste：被浪费掉。**

> Much of the food eventually goes to waste.

### **6. 广告与消费行为**

你的原句：

> Especially under a world full of advertising, may encourage this kind of excessive consuming habits.

这句话缺少主语。

推荐：

接下来你又提到：

其中 *moralities* 不适合这里，*hospitality* 表示热情好客。

原句：

这里存在两个问题：

- *There are several measures can...* 出现两个谓语结构，缺少定语从句。

推荐：

### **2. Solution 1｜生产商和零售商**

原句：

> Firstly, for food producers, they can prompt promotional activities to improve the use of food.

这里的 *prompt promotional activities* 不自然。

- **promote**：推广、促进。
- **promotion**：促销活动。
- **prompt**：促使某事发生。

推荐：

> **Food producers and retailers could offer discounts on surplus products that are still safe to eat.**

但这只是措施。还要解释如何产生作用：

> This would encourage consumers to purchase existing stock before it is discarded.

你原来的低收入家庭论点可以保留：

> **Such discounts could also make food more affordable for low-income families.**

这里还有一个更直接的办法：

原句：

> Second, government should publish reasonable restrictions to reduce wasting movements, like limitation the standard of commuting food and investment of public advertisement to prompt the public awareness of saving food.

| 原表达                                    | 推荐表达                                    |
| -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| government should publish restrictions | governments could introduce regulations |
| wasting movements                      | wasteful practices                      |
| limitation the standard                | set clear standards / require reporting |
| commuting food                         | 含义不明确，无法据此确定你原本想表达的措施                   |
| investment of public advertisement     | invest in public awareness campaigns    |
| prompt the public awareness            | raise public awareness                  |

这里最适合你的两个政府措施是：

> **Governments could require large food retailers to monitor and report the amount of food they discard.**

> **They could also fund public awareness campaigns to encourage more responsible food purchasing and storage habits.**

特别记忆：

**raise public awareness of + 名词**

例如：

- raise public awareness of food waste
- raise public awareness of environmental protection
- raise public awareness of healthy eating

### **4. Solution 3｜个人责任**

你的原句：

> On the top of that, individuals should take their responsibility to save food and reduce waste.

正确搭配是：

- On top of that
- take responsibility for doing something

推荐：

> **Finally, individuals should take responsibility for reducing household waste by planning their purchases and avoiding unnecessary shopping.**

下一句：

> However, with the efforts from producers and governments, I believe it better for individuals shape their healthy consuming habits.

这里缺少 *is* 和 *to*，而且前面的 *However* 没有真正表达转折。

推荐：

> **These wider efforts would be more effective if individuals also developed responsible purchasing habits.**

这个句子可以作为段落收束，因为它强调不同主体的措施如何共同发挥作用。

## **P4｜Conclusion**

你的原文：

> In conclusion, the food waste has become an urgent problem and everyone should pay attention to it. To address this problem, the governmental restrictions, producers’ movements and personal awareness should be implement together, and then less food will be wasted in the future.

主要问题：

- **the food waste**：泛指时不需要 *the*。
- **everyone should pay attention to it**：比较空泛。
- **producers' movements**：搭配错误。
- **should be implement**：应为 *should be implemented*。
- **less food will be wasted**：表达可以，但结论缺乏概括性。

另外，结尾不需要机械重复“政府、企业、个人”所有措施。

推荐：

> **In conclusion, food waste is largely caused by excess supply and unnecessary purchases. Better stock management, targeted government policies and more responsible consumption habits could substantially reduce the amount of edible food discarded.**

这版既回答了原因，也回答了措施，适合原因与解决方案题型。

# **三、两版完整优化作文**

## **版本 A｜尽量保留你原意的修正版**

这一版保留你的圣诞节例子、广告与消费习惯、低收入家庭，以及政府—企业—个人三个层面的措施。

Large quantities of food are thrown away every day in many countries. This problem can largely be attributed to an oversupply of food and wasteful purchasing habits. This essay will examine these causes and suggest possible measures involving food businesses, governments and individuals.

One major cause of food waste is that modern production systems allow businesses to supply large quantities of food at relatively low prices. However, when food supply exceeds actual demand, products with a short shelf life may remain unsold and eventually be discarded. For example, supermarkets may stock extra fresh food before major holidays such as Christmas, only to throw away some of it afterwards. Another cause is that consumers often purchase more food than they actually need. Advertising and promotional offers can encourage unnecessary purchases, while social expectations surrounding generous meals may lead people to prepare excessive amounts of food. As a result, much of this surplus food eventually goes to waste.

Several measures could help reduce this problem. Firstly, food producers and retailers could offer discounts on surplus products that are still safe to eat. This would reduce waste while making food more affordable for low-income families. Businesses could also donate suitable surplus food to those in need. Secondly, governments could introduce regulations requiring large retailers to monitor food waste and invest in public awareness campaigns promoting responsible consumption. Finally, individuals should plan their purchases carefully, avoid buying unnecessary quantities and make better use of leftovers. These measures would be more effective if businesses, governments and households worked together.

In conclusion, excessive food supply and irresponsible purchasing habits are two important causes of food waste. Coordinated efforts to improve stock management and encourage more responsible consumption could considerably reduce the amount of food thrown away.

## **版本 B｜更接近 Band 7.5–8 的优化版**

这一版的重点是让论证更精确，减少重复表达，并让每项措施对应明确的原因。

Large quantities of edible food are discarded worldwide every day. Two major causes are the mismatch between food supply and actual demand and the tendency of consumers to buy more than they need. Addressing this problem requires coordinated action from businesses, governments and individuals.

One major cause is excessive food supply. Modern production and distribution systems allow large quantities of food to reach shops at relatively low prices. However, retailers may overestimate demand, particularly before major holidays, leaving perishable products unsold. Since fresh food has a limited shelf life, some of this stock may eventually be discarded. Another contributing factor is unnecessary purchasing. Convenient shopping and promotional offers can encourage consumers to buy more than they can eat, while social expectations surrounding generous meals may reinforce this behaviour. Consequently, food that is still edible may go to waste.

Reducing this waste requires action at different stages of the food supply chain. Producers and retailers could improve demand forecasting and offer discounts on surplus products that are approaching their use-by dates but remain safe to eat. Suitable unsold food could also be donated to food banks instead of being discarded. Governments could introduce requirements for large retailers to track and report food waste, while funding public campaigns on meal planning and proper food storage. At the household level, consumers should avoid unnecessary bulk purchases and make better use of leftovers. Together, these measures would address both commercial oversupply and wasteful consumption.

In conclusion, food waste is driven largely by poor supply management and excessive purchasing. Better business practices, targeted policies and more responsible household habits could substantially reduce the amount of edible food discarded.

With relevant experience, sufficient financial resources and a realistic understanding of the market, they can become far more manageable.

Many cities are reducing space for private cars in city centres and creating more areas for walking, cycling and public use. Overall, I consider this a positive development because it can support healthier lifestyles and create a more liveable urban environment.

Admittedly, reducing space for private cars can cause inconvenience and reduce travel flexibility for some residents. Although alternative forms of public transport, such as subways and shuttle buses, may be available, they cannot always take passengers directly to their destinations. As a result, commuters may have to follow fixed routes, make transfers or spend more time travelling than they would by car. These restrictions may create even greater difficulties for elderly and disabled residents. If they have to walk longer distances between transport stops and their destinations, people with mobility or health problems may find city-centre travel considerably more difficult.

Nevertheless, the broader benefits for transport, public health and the urban environment are likely to outweigh these inconveniences. Reducing the dominance of private cars can encourage people to shift towards walking, cycling and public transport, potentially lowering traffic volumes in congested city centres. At the same time, pedestrian areas and cycle lanes make active travel safer and more convenient, allowing physical activity to become part of residents' daily routines. Reclaiming road space can also create more attractive public areas, while fewer vehicles mean lower exhaust emissions and traffic noise. Together, these changes can make city centres healthier, cleaner and more pleasant places in which to live and spend time.

In conclusion, although reducing space for private cars may inconvenience some residents, particularly those with limited mobility, the broader benefits can make city centres healthier, cleaner and more liveable places for the majority of people.

Nowadays, an increasing amount of household waste is being produced, much of which is disposed of rather than recycled. This essay will examine the main reasons for this problem and discuss possible solutions involving both governments and individuals.

The growing problem of household waste can largely be attributed to excessive consumption and inadequate recycling systems. As consumer goods become more affordable and shopping more convenient, people are increasingly encouraged to buy more than they actually need. This often results in unused products, leftover food and unnecessary packaging being thrown away, increasing the amount of household waste generated. Meanwhile, inadequate recycling infrastructure makes it difficult for households to dispose of waste responsibly. In areas where separate collection bins and reliable recycling services are unavailable, residents may find sorting waste inconvenient or even pointless. As a result, recyclable materials are often mixed with general household waste and end up being discarded rather than properly recycled.

Addressing this problem requires both government investment in recycling infrastructure and more responsible behaviour among individuals. Governments should provide accessible recycling facilities, clearly labelled bins and reliable collection services. These measures would make waste separation more convenient and encourage households to participate in recycling, allowing more materials to be collected and processed properly. Meanwhile, individuals should adopt more responsible consumption habits by avoiding unnecessary purchases and choosing products with less packaging. This would reduce the amount of waste generated in the first place, rather than relying entirely on recycling after products have been discarded. They should also separate recyclable materials from general waste to make the recycling process more effective. Together, these efforts could reduce unnecessary waste and improve recycling rates.

In conclusion, reducing household waste requires a combination of effective public policies and responsible individual behaviour. By working together, governments and citizens can improve resource use and reduce the environmental impact of waste.

Some argue that regular exercise is the most effective way to maintain good health, while others believe that a healthy diet is more important. This essay will discuss both views and argue that, on balance, combining regular exercise with a healthy diet offers the greatest benefits.

Regular exercise plays an important role in improving physical fitness, supporting metabolic health and promoting psychological well-being. Physically, it strengthens the cardiovascular system and muscles, while helping the body regulate blood sugar and use energy more efficiently. These benefits can help people maintain a healthy weight and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as diabetes. Exercise also benefits mental health by relieving stress and improving mood, particularly among people who feel overwhelmed by work or study. In addition, regular physical activity can improve sleep quality, contributing to better overall well-being.

A healthy diet is equally important because it provides essential nutrients, helps maintain a healthy weight and reduces the risk of diet-related diseases. Foods rich in protein, vitamins and minerals support growth, tissue repair and normal bodily functions, ensuring that people meet their daily nutritional needs. In addition, limiting excessive sugar, salt and unhealthy fats can help prevent weight gain and reduce the risk of obesity. However, diet and exercise are most effective when combined, as they support different aspects of health. People may still gain weight if they consume too much unhealthy food, even if they exercise regularly. Conversely, a balanced diet alone cannot provide the cardiovascular and muscular benefits of physical activity. Therefore, maintaining long-term health requires attention to both eating habits and exercise routines.

In conclusion, regular exercise and a healthy diet play complementary roles in maintaining good health. Combining the two is therefore the most effective way to support long-term physical and mental well-being.
